subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin asks the map provider if the key is real this time or if he is being fooled again.
source_quote: "Is this key for real this time, or are you just fucking with us again?"

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin says he will argue with Kalan later about the fake key.
source_quote: Later is a real place. We'd get there, and Kalan and I would have words in it.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin calls Kalan 'Little Rotund' as Kalan falls behind.
source_quote: "Little Rotund," I said, mostly to myself.

subject: Kalan
fact: Kalan gave the group a fake key because he thought they would be safer with it.
source_quote: he'd figured that if they saw us with a fake key, we'd be safer.

subject: Kalan
fact: Kalan could not trust the group with the real key.
source_quote: He couldn't trust us with the real one, given...

subject: Kalan
fact: Kalan was left behind, panting and out of breath, after failing to keep up with the group.
source_quote: He finally planted, hands on knees, done.

subject: Kalan
fact: Kalan asked if Tadric was alive after the battle.
source_quote: Is Kalan alive?

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin tells Tadric that Kalan was alive when they left him, but his breathing was bad.
source_quote: When we left him, yeah. But he was breathing really hard because he was running, so who knows how things ended there.

subject: Tadric
fact: Tadric was grappled and torn apart by a pit fiend in the domed rotunda.
source_quote: The creature had beaten us here. It was on Tadric, had him grappled to the floor, and it was tearing him apart the way you'd tear bread.

subject: Tadric
fact: Tadric regained consciousness and grabbed for the key before recognizing the dead fiend.
source_quote: The boy came around grabbing for the key before his eyes had finished focusing.

subject: Tadric
fact: Tadric identifies the dead fiend as Moziqodo, Sylvira Savikas's son.
source_quote: "Moziqodo," he said. "Sylvira Savikas's son."

subject: pit fiend
fact: A pit fiend was grappling and tearing apart Tadric in the domed rotunda.
source_quote: The creature had beaten us here. It was on Tadric, had him grappled to the floor, and it was tearing him apart the way you'd tear bread.

subject: pit fiend
fact: The pit fiend did not notice Thorin and the others entering the room because it was focused on killing Tadric.
source_quote: It hadn't looked up. It was still busy with its kill, certain of its evening.

subject: pit fiend
fact: The pit fiend flinched and recoiled when Thorin struck it with Dawnbringer.
source_quote: the fiend, a pit fiend, flinched. Recoiled.

subject: pit fiend
fact: The pit fiend was stunned by Zalthir's precise strike and could not guard or respond.
source_quote: The fiend locked. Rigid. Stunned.

subject: pit fiend
fact: The pit fiend was killed by Thorin's two clean strikes.
source_quote: Thorin finished it. One clean strike, and then a second that arrived as a killing thing, and the fiend stopped being a creature and became weight.

subject: pit fiend
fact: The pit fiend had only one plan: kill Tadric, take the key, disengage, and fly away.
source_quote: The fiend had come with exactly one plan: kill the boy, take the key, disengage, fly.

subject: Thorin strikes pit fiend with Dawnbringer
fact: Thorin struck the pit fiend three times with Dawnbringer, radiating light, not fire.
source_quote: Dawnbringer came down. Radiant, not fire. ... Two strikes landed. Then he found more inside himself and struck a third time

subject: Thorin apologizes to Dawnbringer
fact: Thorin apologized to Dawnbringer before fighting the pit fiend because the sword needed reminding it was radiant.
source_quote: He had needed reminding of that, and the sword had required an apology before the fight, and got one.

subject: Zalthir stuns pit fiend
fact: Zalthir used a controlled breath to strike the pit fiend and stun it, seizing its nervous system.
source_quote: I spent a breath. The controlled kind, the kind the monastery drills into you until spending it is no longer a decision: one strike, placed exactly, meant to seize the nervous system and hold it shut.

subject: Zalthir strikes stunned pit fiend
fact: Zalthir struck the stunned pit fiend twice more while it could not guard or respond.
source_quote: I spent two more breaths and struck it twice while it stood there, unable to guard, unable to answer

subject: Grygum throws lightning javelin
fact: Grygum hurled his lightning javelin at the pit fiend, but it missed.
source_quote: Grygum swung wide so the bolt wouldn't catch any of us and hurled his javelin, the lightning one he'd been saving. It hummed past the fiend's shoulder and hit nothing.

subject: Daz fires darts at pit fiend
fact: Daz fired three plain force darts at the pit fiend, conserving his stronger abilities.
source_quote: Three darts of plain force, first level, unerring, while he held the rest of himself in reserve.

subject: Grygum heals Tadric
fact: Grygum knelt over Tadric and closed his wounds with healing, stopping the bleeding.
source_quote: Grygum knelt over Tadric and closed him back up, the blood slowing and then stopping under his hands.

subject: domed rotunda
fact: The domed rotunda has a curved stone ceiling that carries sound clearly across its span.
source_quote: A real rotunda: curved stone overhead, high and wide, ... And a curve like that does a thing with sound. Stand in the right spot under a dome and a whisper from the far side walks the whole ceiling and lands in your ear like the speaker's beside you.

subject: domed rotunda
fact: The group emerged from a stair into the domed rotunda.
source_quote: The stair put us out at the top of a dome.

subject: Dawnbringer
fact: Dawnbringer is a radiant sword that requires an apology before combat.
source_quote: Dawnbringer came down. Radiant, not fire. He had needed reminding of that, and the sword had required an apology before the fight, and got one.

subject: Dawnbringer
fact: Dawnbringer hummed after Thorin killed the pit fiend.
source_quote: The fiend was on the floor and Dawnbringer was still humming in my grip

subject: lightning javelin
fact: Grygum carried a lightning javelin that he saved for the right moment.
source_quote: hurled his javelin, the lightning one he'd been saving.

subject: the key
fact: Tadric held the real key after the pit fiend was killed.
source_quote: Tadric sat in the wreckage with the key in his fist

subject: Kalan's decoy key
fact: Kalan provided a fake key that the group now possesses.
source_quote: we've got one real key and one fake key.

subject: A'lai Aivenmore
fact: A'lai Aivenmore has the first key, taken from Bookwyrm, and waits in Candlekeep's High Tower.
source_quote: A'lai Aivenmore had the key torn off Bookwyrm, and he was almost certainly sitting in Candlekeep's High Tower right now, waiting for Moziqodo to walk in with the second one.

subject: Candlekeep
fact: Candlekeep's High Tower is the location where A'lai Aivenmore is waiting with the first key.
source_quote: A'lai Aivenmore had the key torn off Bookwyrm, and he was almost certainly sitting in Candlekeep's High Tower right now

subject: Kalan's fate
fact: It is unknown whether Kalan survived after being left behind, out of breath.
source_quote: When we left him, yeah. But he was breathing really hard because he was running, so who knows how things ended there.

subject: deception with fake key
fact: The group plans to use the fake key to deceive whoever holds the real key.
source_quote: Anybody who doesn't know we have a fake key, we can fake them out with it somehow.

subject: confrontation with A'lai Aivenmore
fact: The group intends to confront A'lai Aivenmore in Candlekeep's High Tower to claim both keys.
source_quote: So we show up at Candlekeep's High Tower, challenge him, get both keys, and then we own Candlekeep?

subject: negotiation for boon
fact: The group plans to defer negotiation for a boon until after they have secured both keys.
source_quote: You wait until the other side knows exactly what you're worth, and then you stand where you stand and let the ground do the talking.

subject: Thorin defeats pit fiend
fact: Thorin killed the pit fiend with two clean strikes after it was stunned.
source_quote: Thorin finished it. One clean strike, and then a second that arrived as a killing thing

subject: group wins domed rotunda
fact: The group won control of the domed rotunda by defeating the pit fiend and saving Tadric.
source_quote: We'd won the room. The problem had left the room a while ago.

subject: group reveals truth to Tadric
fact: Thorin told Tadric the full truth about the keys and the mission after the battle.
source_quote: I figure we might as well tell him what's going on. ... Radical transparency's cheaper than managing a man's ignorance anyway.

subject: session time
fact: The events occurred after a long journey underground with no ceiling for months.
source_quote: the first ceiling in months that didn't make me feel like cargo.
